minimax_h3_prompt_reference_doc.text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the female character whose face, hair, costume, and entire appearance are copied exactly from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is the fantasy stone-path environment whose every detail — glowing mushrooms, stone statues, floating castle, waterfalls, butterflies, lighting, color palette, and atmosphere — is copied exactly from <Picture 2>. The background must not be changed to a real-world rural road or farmland under any circumstances.
<Subject 3> is the red vintage tractor whose entire appearance, paint, shape, and details are copied exactly from <Picture 3>.
<Audio 1> is the complete audio track "拖拉机才是乡村.mp3", reused directly as the target video's full soundtrack.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reuse] The target video shows <Subject 1> driving <Subject 3> forward along the stone path in <Subject 2>. The camera tracks backward in front of the tractor throughout, maintaining a medium close-up so the character's face is always clearly visible. She makes playful expressions toward the lens — a peace sign, a smug grin, a startled reaction when hitting a bump, then a recovered smile — while the tractor jolts and bounces on the uneven stone path. <Audio 1> is reused 1:1 as the complete audio track.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the character's face, hairstyle, hair ornaments, forehead mark, costume, and entire appearance are copied exactly from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - every element of the fantasy environment — the stone path, glowing mushrooms, stone statues on both sides, floating castle in the distance, waterfalls, butterflies, vegetation, lighting, and blue-purple color tone — is copied exactly from <Picture 2>. No real-world rural road, farmland, or ordinary trees are introduced.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the tractor's red paint, grille, headlights, exhaust pipe, tires, rear bed, and all details are copied exactly from <Picture 3>.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - <Audio 1> is reused 1:1 as the target video's complete final audio track.

detailed_description:
The target video has a whimsical live-action style. The camera moves backward in front of the tractor at a matching speed throughout the entire video, maintaining a medium close-up framing so the driver's face is always large and clearly visible in the frame. The background behind the tractor remains the fantasy stone-path environment from <Picture 2> at all times — glowing blue-purple mushrooms, stone goddess statues on both sides, floating castle in the distance, and butterflies — and must never turn into a real-world rural dirt road or farmland.

[Shot 1] A medium close-up: the camera tracks backward in front of <Subject 3> as it drives forward along the stone path. <Subject 1> is seated in the driver's seat, her face clearly visible, looking directly at the camera. She raises one hand and makes a peace sign "V" gesture with a cheerful, bright smile. The tractor bounces gently on the uneven stone surface, and her body sways naturally with the chassis movement. The fantasy environment from <Picture 2> streams past in the background. <Audio 1> plays continuously underneath.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the camera continues tracking backward in the same medium close-up. <Subject 1> lowers the peace-sign hand, leans back slightly, and breaks into a smug, self-satisfied grin, one hand resting casually on the steering wheel. The road ahead becomes rougher with uneven stones and small ruts. Suddenly the tractor lurches upward, bouncing hard on its suspension. <Subject 1>'s eyes go wide, her mouth drops open in alarm, and she grips the steering wheel tightly with both hands as her upper body jerks upward with the bounce, her hair ornaments and sleeves flying. The background environment from <Picture 2> continues scrolling past. <Audio 1> continues.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera keeps tracking backward as the tractor settles back onto all four wheels. <Subject 1> blinks, takes a breath, and immediately recovers a bright smile, her shoulders relaxing. She looks back at the camera with a small, sheepish but cheerful expression as the tractor continues rolling forward. Her robes flutter slightly in the wind. The fantasy environment from <Picture 2> remains consistent in the background. <Audio 1> plays through to the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
The full audio signal from <Audio 1> serves as the complete ambience and physical-sound layer across the entire video. No additional synthesized sounds are generated.

non_diegetic_music:
<Audio 1> is directly reused as the complete audience-only background score for the target video.
